## Follow-up review

Pure rename of `src/a.ts` → `src/lib/a.ts` with the same `fetchUser` body. No new issues in the rename itself (no remaining in-repo callers of the old path).

The open warning on the hard-coded 250 ms timeout is **still open**: the call is now `http.get(\`/users/${id}\`, { timeout: 250 })` at `src/lib/a.ts:1`. The move did not make the timeout configurable.

**Recommendation:** comment-only
